# Weeknight Pasta — Quick Reference

A completely unrelated document, used to exercise the gross-divergence
short-circuit in `validate` (FR-036a / SC-017): running `validate unrelated.md
agreement.pdf` must report `summary.gross_divergence = true`, emit a single
summary issue plus structural issues only, skip the local-LLM semantic pass, and
finish without a reachable LLM.

## Ingredients

- 400 g dried spaghetti
- 3 tbsp olive oil
- 4 garlic cloves, thinly sliced
- 1 tsp chili flakes
- a handful of parsley, chopped
- salt, black pepper, grated pecorino

## Method

1. Boil the pasta in well-salted water until al dente; reserve a cup of the water.
2. Gently warm the oil, garlic and chili until the garlic is pale gold.
3. Toss the drained pasta through the oil with a splash of pasta water.
4. Finish with parsley, pecorino and plenty of pepper.

Serves two. Total time about fifteen minutes.
